name: Les Utopiales
blurb: Nantes' multidisciplinary science-fiction festival spanning literature, cinema, comics, science talks and games.

editions.evidence: Homepage: 'From October 29 to November 1, 2026, Les Utopiales, International Science Fiction Festival'; programme grid confirms the same Thu-Sun span (plus a Wed 28 Oct preview event).

notes: Guests could not be reliably captured: the site's full guest list at /guest/ is one undated, alphabetical archive spanning the festival's entire 20+ year history (~2,500 people per the festival's own count, 21 pages), with no edition/year filter found within the research budget. A few photos in it are explicitly credited '...Utopiales 2026' (e.g. Isabelle Bary), confirming this year's guests are mixed in, but isolating a clean 2026-only subset wasn't possible this session, so guests is 'unavailable' rather than guessed from the mixed archive or from unverified WebSearch name snippets. The 2026 key-art cover (illustration by Léa Murawiec) was found on the programme sub-page, not the homepage, whose own og/twitter images are a generic cropped banner.
